description: This file implements cache version upgrade and maintenance functions for the Chromium project, specifically handling disk cache index upgrades, fake index file creation, and cache cleanup routines.

classes.name: FakeIndexData
classes.description: Structure representing the fake index file header data used during cache upgrade.

methods.name: LogMessageFailedUpgradeFromVersion
methods.description: Logs an error message indicating failure to upgrade from a specific cache version.

methods.name: WriteFakeIndexFile
methods.description: Creates and writes a fake index file with initial magic number and version info.

methods.name: UpgradeIndexV5V6
methods.description: Handles upgrading the cache index from version 5 to version 6 by deleting the old index file.

methods.name: UpgradeSimpleCacheOnDisk
methods.description: Main routine to upgrade the cache on disk, handling version checks, index upgrades, and fake index file creation.

methods.name: DeleteIndexFilesIfCacheIsEmpty
methods.description: Deletes index files and directories if the cache directory is empty.
